proofBoundary: TensorRtExec and OnnxToEngine reports are build/report evidence. They do not replace real-model-runtime or package-consumer-runtime proof.

validationItems.message: TensorRtExec report exists.
Report must contain top-level property Success.
Report must contain top-level property Skipped.
Report must contain top-level property State.
Report must contain top-level property TensorRtLine.
Report must contain top-level property ModelSource.
Report must contain top-level property EnginePath.
Report must contain top-level property Parsed.
Report must contain top-level property DryRun.
Report must contain top-level property InferenceRan.
Report must contain top-level property OutputMatch.
Report must contain top-level property NormalizedCommandLine.
Report must contain top-level property NormalizedCommandSha256.
Report must contain top-level property DeploymentOptions.
Report must contain top-level property RuntimeOptions.
Report must contain top-level property PreflightMetadata.
Report must contain top-level property LoadedEngineDiagnostics.
Report must contain top-level property CapabilityProbe.
Report must contain top-level property WorkspaceBytes.
Report must contain top-level property OptionImplementationStatus.
Report must contain top-level property ProofClassification.
Report must contain top-level property BuildEvidenceOnly.
Report must contain top-level property IsRuntimeExecutionProof.
Report must contain top-level property IsRealModelRuntimeProof.
Report must contain top-level property IsPackageConsumerRuntimeProof.
Report must contain top-level property ModelEvidence.
Report must contain top-level property Diagnostics.
Report must contain top-level property LogLines.
Report must contain top-level property ReportBoundary.
ProofClassification must be known.
NormalizedCommandSha256 must be a lowercase SHA256 string.
ReportBoundary must be present.
ReportBoundary.IsRuntimeProof must be false for build/report evidence.
ReportBoundary.CopiedDiagnosticsBoundary must be present.
ReportBoundary.ParserDiagnosticsEvidenceKind must be copied-parser-diagnostics.
ReportBoundary.ParserRefitterDiagnosticsEvidenceKind must be copied-parser-refitter-diagnostics.
Copied parser/refitter diagnostics cannot promote runtime proof.
ReportBoundary.ParserDiagnosticsOwnerAction must be present.
ReportBoundary.ForbiddenSubstitutes must include every non-proof substitute.
OptionImplementationStatus must split parsed/applied/parse-only options.
PreflightMetadata.EvidenceBoundary must be present.
LoadedEngineDiagnostics.EvidenceBoundary must be present.
CapabilityProbe.EvidenceBoundary must be present.
TensorRtExec report cannot by itself promote package-consumer-runtime proof.
Report must not refer to the retired YoloDet sample name.
